tools.name: sill_listContents
tools.description: Read cards page by page with limit 1–100. No keyword or type filter. Follow next_cursor; use only a returned sync_cursor as since. Card contract 5.0.0: type selects the card kind; summary is plain text for the card face; body is one CommonMark Markdown string, never an array or JSON-encoded string. Use native JSON objects/arrays/numbers/booleans for structured fields. Omit unknown facts. No points, card.meta or files[].meta/time. Personal notes belong to state.note. Dates retain their precision; scheduling timestamps use Unix milliseconds; media offsets and durations use seconds.

expected_owner.description: Optional account guard from an authenticated host; grants no permissions. Keep it unchanged when retrying a request.

audioUrl.description: Podcast audio URL, read only during playback. Not an acquisition or sync source.

chapters.description: Media only: {start,title} chapters, with start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Never invent timestamps.

transcript.description: Media only: actual timestamped transcript {start,text}; start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Ordinary notes belong in body.

pullRequest.description: Required for type=pr only: repository (owner/repo), positive number, state and observedAt (offset ISO datetime). Optional branches, reviewers, checks and statistics reflect observed evidence. Only completed checks may have conclusion. Omit unknown counts, retain known zeros. Never presented as live GitHub state.

title.description: Specific plain-text title; do not place the full body here.

summary.description: Card face summary: one or two plain-text sentences for the feed card and search results; for photos, the factual image description. Not shown in the detail; put all detail text in body.

authors.description: Original authors, publisher or mail sender, not sources or the writing agent. The first author is shown as the mail sender. Applies to article, note, mail, media, digest, suggestion and file.

publishedAt.description: Original publication, send or capture date, or offset datetime. Preserve date-only precision.

project.description: Task or reminder only: existing project name and optional HTTP(S) link.

form.description: Note only: quote shows the title as a quotation. Omit for the default layout.

images.description: Built-in illustrative asset IDs or HTTPS image URLs, not uploads. The first image is the cover; photo cards show all. Required for video and photo cards; never substitute for a real user photo.

tags.description: Content tags. Editing tags edits the card.

url.description: Original HTTP(S) source link; video uses its platform page URL. Not an upload or fetch instruction.

sources.description: Acquisition sources as {name,kind}; not authors. Records provenance without connecting to the source.

location.description: Known event or photo location; omit if unavailable.

meeting.description: Existing meeting reference {name,url,code?}, not a request to create a meeting. Never store credentials in the URL or code.

media.description: Media subtype, independent of type=media and file MIME type.

duration.description: Known media duration in integer seconds. Unknown is omitted, not zero.

files.description: Files or mail attachments: name, optional MIME type, integer sizeBytes, original modifiedAt and HTTP(S) url. No binary/base64 upload. File cards require a nonempty list.

tasks.description: Task card actionable subtasks as {id,text}; use nonempty tasks with unique stable IDs. Completion is personal state taskDone. Markdown checkboxes do not create interactive tasks.

start.description: Event start as Unix milliseconds, greater than zero; pair with end.

end.description: Event end as Unix milliseconds, strictly later than start.

due.description: Known task/reminder due time as Unix milliseconds; recording it does not schedule an external notification.

time.description: Card timeline time in Unix milliseconds; separate from publishedAt.

people.description: Event only: known attendees; do not invent participants.

related.description: Real Sill card IDs read under the current permissions; not titles or URLs.

priority.description: Priority from 0 to 10, only when requested or supported by source facts.

playbackPosition.description: Actual playback position in seconds, separate from reading progress; saving position does not mark read.

tools.name: sill_createContent
tools.description: Create one card with body:{type,title,...fields}; its nested body is Markdown. Prefer typed fields for tasks, meetings, files (including mail attachments), images, media chapters/transcript and PR snapshots. Unknown or removed fields are rejected. PR requires pullRequest with repository, number, state and observedAt. Read the returned ID to verify saved fields. Card contract 5.0.0: type selects the card kind; summary is plain text for the card face; body is one CommonMark Markdown string, never an array or JSON-encoded string. Dates retain their precision; scheduling timestamps use Unix milliseconds; media offsets and durations use seconds. Use a new idempotency_key for a new write; after an unknown result, verify first and retry only with the same key and identical arguments. A Sill write does not execute an external action.

tools.name: sill_applyOperations
tools.description: Apply an atomic batch: card.upsert, card.delete, item.patch, preferences.patch, reading.add. Up to 5000 operations and 512 KiB UTF-8 request body. Requires whole-workspace read access plus permission for each write. Use original before or workspace expectedRevision; new card.upsert requires before:null and a new card.id. card is a full replacement: preserve existing facts, remove server metadata and state; put state in item.patch. Inspect the returned snapshot; no event metadata in a batch. Card contract 5.0.0: type selects the card kind; summary is plain text for the card face; body is one CommonMark Markdown string, never an array or JSON-encoded string. Use native JSON objects/arrays/numbers/booleans for structured fields. Omit unknown facts. No points, card.meta or files[].meta/time. Personal notes belong to state.note. Dates retain their precision; scheduling timestamps use Unix milliseconds; media offsets and durations use seconds. Use a new idempotency_key for a new write; after an unknown result, verify first and retry only with the same key and identical arguments. A Sill write does not execute an external action.

expected_owner.description: Optional account guard from an authenticated host; grants no permissions. Keep it unchanged when retrying a request.

idempotency_key.description: New UUID per logical write. Reuse the exact key and arguments only when retrying that same write after checking an unknown result.

audioUrl.description: Podcast audio URL, read only during playback. Not an acquisition or sync source.

chapters.description: Media only: {start,title} chapters, with start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Never invent timestamps.

transcript.description: Media only: actual timestamped transcript {start,text}; start in seconds, strictly increasing and within known duration. Ordinary notes belong in body.
